items.title: Remove unauthorized carport
items.quote: Ich gebe Ihnen daher nach § 82 BauO NRW auf, den Carport bis spätestens 28.11.2025 vollständig zu beseitigen.
items.computation: The letter states an explicit calendar date for the obligation: 28.11.2025. This is used as written (a printed calendar date is not recomputed). 28.11.2025 is a Friday, so no weekend/holiday adjustment is needed.

items.title: File Klage (lawsuit) against the Ordnungsverfügung at Verwaltungsgericht Gelsenkirchen
items.quote: die Klage ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe zu erheben.
items.computation: Sender is a city (general authority), not a tax office, so the delivery day is not shifted even if it falls on a weekend/holiday. Letter dated/posted 22.09.2025 (Monday); posted after 1 Jan 2025, so delivery is deemed on the 4th day after posting: 23.09 (day1), 24.09 (day2), 25.09 (day3), 26.09.2025 Friday (day4) = Bekanntgabe. One-month period under §§ 187 Abs.1, 188 Abs.2 BGB (via § 57 VwGO/§74 VwGO): the day of delivery (26.09) is not counted; the period ends on the day with the same number in the following month, i.e. 26.10.2025. 26.10.2025 is a Sunday, so under § 57 Abs.2 VwGO with § 222 Abs.2 ZPO the deadline moves to the next working day: Monday 27.10.2025 (no NRW or nationwide holiday falls on that Monday).

warnings: A Zwangsgeld (coercive fine) of 2.000,00 € is threatened only if the removal deadline of 28.11.2025 is missed; it is not itself currently due.
The letter states the fee for this Ordnungsverfügung will be charged in a separate, later notice (gesonderter Bescheid) — no payment is due from this letter itself.
